item.title: Bokura no Ue ni Sora wa Mawaru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Polarstar
  • 発売日: 2013-03-29
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (36 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 僕らの頭上に星空は廻る
  • 英語名: Bokura no Ue ni Sora wa Mawaru

别名

  • BokuSora

あらすじ

Hitoshi had been in Sakimihara Gakuen for three months and he still hadn’t joined a club. The astronomy club was in danger of disbanding due to the graduation of the third-year students and retirement of their advisor. He ended up being half-forced to join the club by the scheming of his older cousin and teacher Sakura. He met the other members of the club: energetic transfer student Supika, gentle neighbour Kano, shy senpai Sari, childish-looking but reliable Ayane. They were all new to astronomy as well, so their first outings were full of fumbles. However, as time progressed, they gradually began to change.
